question: 2026학년도 1학기 IE419-00(서비스데이터사이언스)와 2026학년도 1학기 SWCON104-01(웹/파이선프로그래밍)의 정규 수업시간이 일주일에 총 몇 분 겹쳐? 시험 일정은 제외하고 요일별 겹치는 구간만 합산해줘.
pred_sql:
WITH slots_a AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ts.day, ts.start_time, ts.end_time
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN class_times ct ON co.offering_id = ct.offering_id
    JOIN time_slots ts ON ct.time_slot_id = ts.time_slot_id
    WHERE co.year = 2026 AND co.semester = '1'
      AND co.course_code = 'IE419' AND co.section = '00'
),
slots_b AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ts.day, ts.start_time, ts.end_time
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN class_times ct ON co.offering_id = ct.offering_id
    JOIN time_slots ts ON ct.time_slot_id = ts.time_slot_id
    WHERE co.year = 2026 AND co.semester = '1'
      AND co.course_code = 'SWCON104' AND co.section = '01'
),
overlaps AS (
    SELECT
        a.day,
        MAX(
            CAST(SUBSTR(a.start_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(a.start_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER),
            CAST(SUBSTR(b.start_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(b.start_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)
        ) AS overlap_start,
        MIN(
            CAST(SUBSTR(a.end_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(a.end_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER),
            CAST(SUBSTR(b.end_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(b.end_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)
        ) AS overlap_end
    FROM slots_a a
    JOIN slots_b b ON a.day = b.day
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN overlap_end > overlap_start THEN overlap_end - overlap_start ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overlap_minutes
FROM overlaps;
